name: GitHub Organization Members Without MFA Review
description: Adds a Control Test Result and creates tasks for GitHub organization members returned by GitHub's two-factor-authentication-disabled filter.

mapping.notes: Reviews multi-factor authentication enrollment for direct members of the selected GitHub organization. Confirm organization-owner access and the intended membership scope before enabling this workflow. A complete collection passes when no members without multi-factor authentication are found and fails when such members are found. Incomplete collection is inconclusive; collection or data-processing failures are errors. This does not assess policy enforcement, authentication method strength, outside collaborators, or identities outside the selected organization.

mapping.task_title_template: Enable MFA for GitHub user {{ record.login }}
mapping.additional_information_template: GitHub returned organization member {{ record.login }} (user ID {{ record.id }}) from the organization-owner-only 2fa_disabled member filter. Confirm the account still requires organization access, then require the user to enable an approved MFA method in GitHub.
